messages:
Noah (new PM): Hey folks 44b just joined product today. Quick setup and process q's: how do I get Figma access, where's the canonical product roadmap, and what does the PM <> Design handoff for research briefs look like? cc @Adele

Adele (Design Lead): welcome Noah! For Figma we use SSO. Steps are basically: 
```
Okta -> Apps -> Request 'Figma (Redwood)'
```
If it sits pending DM @Ravi and he'll force-invite. I'll also add you to the Product UI Kit and the current sprint file once your account is active.

Ravi (Design Ops): hi Noah 44b auto-approvals run M-F 9-6 PT; sometimes contractors get manual checks. If you see "pending" send me the Okta request id and I'll expedite. Our Figma team name is "Redwood - Product".

Noah (new PM): thanks. roadmap location? and on briefs, do you want a full spec or a short discovery note?

Priya (PM): Roadmap lives in Confluence: /product/strategy/roadmap. We keep a short high-level view there and link to the initiative pages for details. For briefs: start small. Problem + target users + 1-2 hypotheses + 1 success metric is enough to kick off discovery. If it looks like a bigger bet we'll expand the brief. Templates live in Drive -> design/research/playbooks.

Adele (Design Lead): Process for PM <> Design handoff: 1) PM creates short brief and posts it to #design-research with tag "study-request". 2) Design Ops (Ravi) triages screener and recruitment. 3) Designer pairs with PM on study script and prototype. 4) Results go into the playbook and we synth into a short highlight doc. We try to keep the brief under one page unless it's a multi-quarter initiative.

Access Bot: Access request received: 'Figma' submitted by Noah. Ticket #ACC-10112. Est. processing 1-2 hours.

Noah (new PM): I just did the Okta request and it's pending. Ravi I'll DM the id. Also would love a 20-min walkthrough of the roadmap and recent research highlights if anyone has time today.

Ravi (Design Ops): Manual approve done, invite sent to your work email. Added you to Product UI Kit and research-playbooks. Also pinned a "first-week checklist" doc in the playbooks with links to: roadmap, last quarter research synth, design system, and critique calendar.

Adele (Design Lead): I'll do the walkthrough at 4pm PT if that works for you. We'll cover active initiatives, where we keep discovery notes, and who owns the research panel. Welcome aboard!

Noah (new PM): 4pm PT great, thanks everyone 60a I'll bring a couple questions about a nav experiment. See you then!
